reasons: Cited § 8.2 matches the preferred position: successive 12-month renewal terms, Customer opt-out on 30 days' notice, and a Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal (with an opt-out extension if the reminder is missed, which is more favourable to us).
§ 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3%, exactly the preferred cap, with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods.
Deterministic check confirms the notice window is 30 days, well inside the ≤30-day preferred threshold; renewal term is 12 months, so no walk-away trigger.
Compliant status correctly carries no redline and no counterparty comment; the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs.
